lines.text: Whoever slanders his neighbor in secret,
the one with haughty eyes and a proud heart,
My eyes favor the faithful of the land,
that they may dwell with me;
he who walks in the way of integrity
Every morning I will remove all the wicked of the land,
that I may cut off every evildoer from the city of the LORD.

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Joseph Accused by Potiphar's Wife — the woman beside the bed laying the charge while her husband listens, whoever slanders his neighbor in secret
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_laster

pictures.scene: Caravaggio, Conversion on the Way to Damascus — Saul thrown flat on the road under his own horse with his arms open, the one with haughty eyes and a proud heart
pictures.name: pd_caravaggio_trots

pictures.scene: Jules Breton, The Song of the Lark — the barefoot peasant girl standing still in the field at sunrise with her sickle, my eyes favor the faithful of the land
pictures.name: pd_breton_getrouwen

pictures.scene: Altobello Melone, The Road to Emmaus — Christ walking the road beside the disciple and talking with him, he who walks in the way of integrity
pictures.name: pd_melone_wandelt

pictures.scene: Johannes Vermeer, Christ in the House of Martha and Mary — Martha setting the basket of bread down on the table before the Lord, shall minister to me
pictures.name: pd_vermeer_dient

pictures.scene: Georges de La Tour, The Cheat with the Ace of Diamonds — the player glancing sideways while he draws the hidden card out of his belt, no one who practices deceit shall dwell in my house
pictures.name: pd_latour_bedrog

pictures.scene: Cecco del Caravaggio, The Expulsion of the Merchants from the Temple — Christ with the cords raised driving the traders and their cattle down the steps, no one who tells lies shall stand in my presence
pictures.name: pd_cecco_staan

pictures.scene: Johannes Vermeer, View of Delft — the whole town along the water with the church tower standing in the morning light, the city of the LORD
pictures.name: pd_vermeer_stad
